title: Вход
prompt:
Design the BusNow login page, a sibling of the home board, 390px wide, Russian UI, one column on the canvas. Same Golos Text and the same tokens. This is a short form, not a marketing page. No illustration, no photo, no testimonial, no social login.

Structure, top to bottom, page inset 24:
- Top bar: text control «Назад» in muted 15px at the left.
- 32px below: heading «Вход», 22px weight 600 ink. 8px under it, muted 14px «Чтобы запомнить остановку и напоминание.» The heading sits closer to that line than to the form.
- 32px below: label «Почта», 14px muted, then 8px below it a white field, height 44, radius 12, resting shadow, placeholder «you@mail.ru».
- 16px below: label «Пароль», 14px muted, then 8px below it the same white field, placeholder «Пароль».
- 24px below: button «Войти», full width, height 44, radius 12, accent fill #245C4A, white text 15px weight 600, raised shadow.
- 16px below the button: one line, 14px. Muted «Нет аккаунта?» and then the word «Регистрация» in accent. They are one group.
- 48px below: footer «Новополоцк», 13px muted.

Use ONLY the fonts, colors, spacing, radius, shadows, and motion defined in the design system. Do not introduce any fonts, colors, or visual styles not in the design system. Keep Golos Text. Canvas #EFEFEC, surface #FFFFFF, ink #1C1C1A, muted #6B6B66, single accent #245C4A. No gradients, grain, blobs, script, or a second accent.
